stemMd: Which function is odd on the real numbers?
explanationMd: An odd function satisfies f(−x) = −f(x). For x³ − x, substitution gives −x³ + x, exactly the negative of the original. The other choices contain even or constant parts that break this relation.

distractorRationale.c: The constant breaks the odd symmetry.
distractorRationale.b: The mixture does not satisfy f(−x) = −f(x).
